verdict.rationale: First-party docs define per-file, per-folder and per-shared-drive permission resources with granular roles (owner, organizer, fileOrganizer, writer, commenter, reader) and viewer/commenter/editor sharing controls. They also state that access applied to a folder is inherited by all files within it. Missing for 10: deeper documentation of inheritance behavior (e.g., overrides or limits on inherited access), independent or hands-on corroboration.
